purpose: Compare current definition-based method fairly and diagnose why real pose error is worse; no superior-method claim by theory alone
study_status: Exploratory posthoc diagnostic after current benchmark/failure review; all interventions fixed here before their execution

diagnostic_arms.name: RAW_BI_OT
diagnostic_arms.change: Replace frozen B/I xy with original raw xy; retain exact original covariance, states, O/T, solver, starts

diagnostic_arms.name: RAW_BI_NO_OT
diagnostic_arms.change: Same raw xy and corrected covariance; O/T states become U and domains removed

diagnostic_arms.name: CURRENT_RAW_STANDARD_COV
diagnostic_arms.change: Same current states/raw xy/O-T; isotropic sigma B=2px,I=3px
diagnostic_arms.effect: raw noise weighting control, not pure correction comparison

diagnostic_arms.name: ORACLE_BINARY_RAW_STANDARD_COV
diagnostic_arms.change: Keep initial/current S and T gates. Eligible native known human DIRECT/EXTERNAL replaces only actual visibility decision; DIRECT gets initial B/I role, EXTERNAL O. Other physical unknowns U. Raw xy + same B2px/I3px covariance; current nonself query scale held fixed for all O radii
diagnostic_arms.oracle: human state labels, compatible86 only; remaining9 identical control

diagnostic_arms.name: FULL_HUMAN_RAW_STANDARD_COV
diagnostic_arms.change: Compatible human SELF->S,DIRECT->initial B/I role,EXTERNAL->O,UNANNOTATED->U; no independent natural T labels. Raw xy+same B2px/I3px covariance/current fixed query scale. Missing or out-of-frame DIRECT query becomes unresolved U, never fake T
diagnostic_arms.oracle: human-state/raw-query structural oracle; no fresh RGB correction or independent physical pose truth; incompatible9 identical control

diagnostic_arms.name: CURRENT_DROP_KNOWN_FALSE_OT
diagnostic_arms.change: Frozen B/I xy/cov untouched; remove only O with known human DIRECT/SELF or T with compatible valid inframe known DIRECT/EXTERNAL annotation. Removed point state U, no newly added B/I measurements. UNANNOTATED remains unknown
diagnostic_arms.oracle: postseal known-false state deletion; compatible86 only, incompatible9 unchanged

diagnostic_arms.name: CURRENT_BI_BUDGET6
diagnostic_arms.change: maximum_visible_mahalanobis 3->6 only; exact Sigma/objective/states/domains remain fixed
diagnostic_arms.effect: sensitivity of assumed hard observation budget, no learned calibration or deployment selection

diagnostic_arms.name: CURRENT_REFERENCE_MODEL_CENTER_O
diagnostic_arms.change: Same B/I, covariance, O radius and T constraints; O center moved to fixed-phase registered model/reference projection; compatible86 only, incompatible9 unchanged
diagnostic_arms.oracle: historical reference-model projection center, not actual RGB or independent annotation-coordinate localization

diagnostic_arms.name: CURRENT_REFERENCE_INIT
diagnostic_arms.change: Add every allowed physical reference-yaw-symmetry pose transformed to original cf basis as extra initializations; same exact F and loss. All95, report compatible86 separately
diagnostic_arms.oracle: reference initialization only; reference-feasible vs reference-excluded distinguished. No GT best-branch production choice

diagnostic_arms.name: MODEL_IDEAL_PROJECTIONS
diagnostic_arms.change: Use registered geometry S/B/I/T at fixed native-phase model/reference pose; BI exactly projected xy with isotropic1px covariance, eligible human external E gives model-centered O of same empirical widths; start includes construction reference pose
diagnostic_arms.oracle: ideal-model projected observations; no image evidence, physical visibility proof or deployable benchmark

diagnostic_arms.name: FULL_HUMAN_RAW_STANDARD_COV_BUDGET6
diagnostic_arms.change: Same full human-state/raw-query/std-cov oracle plus maximum_visible_mahalanobis6 on eligible86 only. Remaining9 retain exact FULL_HUMAN_RAW_STANDARD_COV control (CURRENT_RAW_STANDARD_COV Maha3), no incompatible native oracle
diagnostic_arms.oracle: Combined known-state and hard-budget diagnostic interaction, not deployment or threshold selected by TEST performance

raw_visible_query_validity: Finite, not[-1,-1], inside strict current canvas; otherwise U plus recorded missing localization reason
reference_phase: Same preexisting native_to_reference mapping; align 3D physical native coordinates by allowed reference yaw symmetry only. Do not minimize GT pixel or prediction pose error for phase selection
reference_metric: Same historical target/C2 pose_metric and all-frame fallback; never omit failed arms
reference_inequality_interpretation: Compute exact solver-normalized individual constraints/positive_depth1e-5/tol1e-7; distinguish native compatibility and all equivalent physical reference poses
covariance_controls: RAW_BI_OT/NO_OT use exact corrected Sigma only to isolate xy. Standard-cov oracle controls use separately matched raw B2px/I3px. No covariance adjustment from TEST outcomes
O_rule: max(8px, frozen current nonself query scale*existing CAL normalized_radius); preserve source model binding. Newly constructed/shifted oracle regions explicitly diagnostic, no fresh image-localization claim
fallback: Exact current valid corrected-BI seed support guards and no underconstrained2BI seed; otherwise original coarse PnP, OT unresolved

selector_diagnostics.SELECT_CLOSEST_COARSE_FIXED: Use only cached feasible samples: minimize RMS projection distance of all8 registered vertices from initial model projection, normalized by max(initial model bboxdiag,16px). Pure model geometry, no S raw coordinates/GT. Exact same feasible pool; current fallback unchanged
selector_diagnostics.ORACLE_BEST_FOUND: One selected pose fixed by minimum translation_cm; report all metrics on this single selected pose. Additionally metric-wise attainable floors can be reported separately and must never be combined into one claimed pose. All are GT oracle sensitivity of finite found samples only, not a method.

required_outputs: All95 per-arm poses, fallback/ambiguity/individual constraints/input provenance
Same-frame pose metrics, success flips, partition/session/win-loss and outlier contributions
2x2 raw/corrected x OT on/off differences and raw covariance/state oracle matched differences
Reference loss/constraint feasibility independent of chosen image objective
critical_limits: Reference poses derived from historical annotations, not independently measured
9 native-registry-incompatible records cannot validate physical pixel oracles; controls kept and all95 pose metrics retained
Oracle and ideal-model results are diagnostic inputs with GT; not deployable competitor scores
Finite SE3 multi-start search and feasible pool do not prove global uniqueness
Constraint subset narrowing alone does not order a weighted image objective optimum by physical pose error
model_ideal_incompatible_policy: For9 native-phase-incompatible records use physical reference phase0 transformed by Q.T to project the current model. Pure current-model internal consistency; no human O applied, no true pixel mapping/recovery claim. Compatible86 and all95 reported separately.
reference_init_interpretation: Additional reference starts can alter both joint search and BI-only seed/fallback; report changed fallback and accepted joint search effects separately.
model_ideal_interpretation: Construction reference feasible and recovered among found candidates are separate from selector pose error; insufficient information can still produce ambiguous ideal-model alternatives.
preexecution_plan_amendment: 11th interaction arm added before any counterfactual execution after reference-feasibility diagnosis showed overlapping BI/state/OT failures; existing real benchmark already known and explicitly posthoc. No counterfactual outcome inspected before adding this arm.
